hints: The week is taken off the page when it leaves the screen, and the requests still go out. So something that the week started keeps running without it. What in `client/src/components/WeekPanel.tsx` runs again and again on its own?

The refresh is a `setInterval` created inside a `useEffect`. An interval does not belong to the component: the browser keeps calling it until someone cancels it, whether the component is on the page or not.

An effect can return a function, and React calls it when the component leaves the page (and before the effect runs again). That is the place to undo what the effect started: keep what `setInterval` returns and pass it to `clearInterval`.
